correctness.rationale: For H_3^t with independent centers, the commutator vanishes iff all t symplectic determinants vanish. Each neighborhood is the direct sum of coordinate perpendiculars and is proper but has nonzero elements supported in two separate factors; the sum of their centralizers is the full quotient. This exactly proves two strict enlargements and only trivial closed subspaces. Intersections of two coordinate perpendiculars are zero iff the coordinate vectors are independent, and explicit disjoint-support intermediates prove distance exactly three in that event. The finite-field independent-pair product gives the ordered census. Independent exact finite enumeration agrees for t=2,q=2,3 and t=3,q=2; no computational assumption is used in the all-field proof.

value.rationale: The main source expressly asks to characterize equality between reduced commuting graph height and ordinary diameter. This provides a natural infinite nilpotent family with strict separation in every characteristic and all factor counts, a complete closed-subspace classification, an if-and-only-if distance-three geometric criterion, and a precise finite-field extremal-pair census. Those refinements go beyond the previously established decomposable diameter bound.
